summary: Apply HAZOP, MOC, barrier assurance, and process-safety indicators. Explore this practical five-day training course.
lede: Process safety governance training helps plant and safety professionals control hazards, changes, and critical safeguards. Engineers, plant managers, operations and maintenance leaders, and OHS professionals practise risk-ranked HAZID and HAZOP reviews, assess management-of-change impacts, and verify safety-critical controls. Exercises also cover incident learning, barrier assurance, and process-safety indicator reporting using methods such as CCPS Risk Based Process Safety, bow-tie analysis, and API RP 754.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess process hazards, authorize plant changes, maintain safeguards, or review process-safety performance in manufacturing, water treatment, food processing, energy, and chemical storage.
modules: Process Safety and CCPS RBPS Foundations
API RP 754 Metrics and Incident Learning
Process Safety Governance and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior exposure to plant operations, process engineering, maintenance, OHS, auditing, or operational risk is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel for the dashboard exercise; Power BI is optional. Advanced functional safety topics receive conceptual coverage, while hazard review, MOC, and indicator exercises use operational application.
